title: Health and Fitness Program for Justice-Involved Youth
agency_path: City of New York > Administration for Children's Services
description_text:
Through this Request for Proposals (RFP), ACS is seeking a qualified vendor to provide health and fitness programming to justice-involved youth. The programs would engage housed youth detained and/or remanded at ACS detention facilities in rigorous physical activity as well as in health and wellness educational programming in accordance with the Center for Disease Controls (CDC) recommendation for adolescents to engage in regular daily, mostly moderate or vigorous intensity, aerobic physical activity.

Special Case Determination not required because procurement is for Client/Human Services and is the preferred method under PPB Rule 3-01 (c).
